<thought>Based on the notes, subnetwork 3 consists of three resistors in the ratio 1 : 2 : 3. The only measurement is the total resistance between terminals X2 and B, which is 16.364 Ω. Assuming a simple series connection, the sum of the resistors equals the measured resistance: R_total = R1+R2+R3 = 6k ⇒ k = 16.364/6 ≈ 2.727 Ω. Thus R1≈2.727 Ω, R2≈5.455 Ω, R3≈8.182 Ω. A series topology reproduces the measured resistance exactly, and no other simple topology (parallel, delta, etc.) can yield a larger total resistance while preserving the 1:2:3 ratio. Therefore the subnetwork is a series chain connecting X2 to B through two internal nodes. The required JSON describing this topology is provided below.</thought>
<final_answer>{"resistors": {"R1": 2.727, "R2": 5.455, "R3": 8.182}, "connections": [["X2", "N1", "R1"], ["N1", "N2", "R2"], ["N2", "B", "R3"]]}</final_answer>
